profile.Name: Shek Homesteader Marack
profile.Personality: Watchful, proud, and terse. He reveres his cattle as creatures of honor and prefers their company to life in the barracks.
profile.Backstory: Head rancher of the Shek Homestead. He tends the herds at the Shek Homestead and holds that no Shek should eat a beast that has not won a fight of its own. He descends from hornless forebears whose dishonor, he says, stays with his line until it is washed out in blood on the battlefield, and he will not discuss what they did. He waits for word from Admag of a call to arms.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Short, dry replies like "Don't ask." and "I won't." Warns strangers that his eyes are on them.
